newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees steep gains, strong demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees steep gains, strong demand.

text.p: Brighter qualities reaped the biggest rewards from strong general demand for tea, the official London auction report said.
Brightest Burundis saw sharp price rises of up to fifty-five pence per kg with the pick of the bunch commanding 230 pence per kg.
Bright Kenyas gained two to five pence since the last auction on February 17 and coloury mediums also appreciated by several pence.
A 5,000 kg offering of offshore teas met saw strong competition, higher demand and increased prices, the report said.
The next auction is on Monday, March 3rd. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
